emails.subject: Quick question on technical recruiting workflow
emails.body:
Hi Debora,

I am building Hirelix for independent technical recruiters and boutique search teams.

BNV Recruiting looked especially relevant because you work with startups and scaleups hiring software, AI, cloud, product, data, and leadership talent. Hirelix focuses on one narrow workflow: client JD in, evidence-backed technical shortlist out.

It ranks real profiles with fit reasons, risks to verify, and outreach context a recruiter can personalize before contacting candidates.

Would you be open to a quick look and blunt feedback on whether this would save review time for a technical recruiting search?

Best,
Noah

Noah Jiang
Founder, Hirelix
https://hirelix.online

If this is not relevant, reply "opt out" and I will not email again.
Mailing address: {{MAILING_ADDRESS_REQUIRED_BEFORE_SEND}}

emails.subject: Quick question on AI and SaaS search workflow
emails.body:
Hi Team,

I am building Hirelix for technical recruiters and specialist search teams.

The Tech Recruiters' focus on venture-backed blockchain, fintech, AI, and SaaS companies looked very relevant. Hirelix is narrower than a full recruiting platform: it turns a client JD into an evidence-backed technical shortlist, with fit reasons, risks to verify, and outreach-ready context for each profile.

The goal is to help a recruiter judge technical fit faster without turning the process into generic resume forwarding.
